Family & Cosmetic Dentistry You Can Trust

At Brightline Dental, we combine gentle care with modern techniques to keep your whole family smiling. From routine checkups to smile makeovers, our Riverton team is here for you.

Book an Appointment

Our Services

We offer comprehensive dental care for patients of all ages, from preventive cleanings to advanced cosmetic treatments.

Preventive Checkups

Routine exams and cleanings to catch problems early and keep your smile healthy year-round.

Teeth Whitening

Professional-grade whitening treatments for a brighter, more confident smile in one visit.

Orthodontics

Traditional braces and clear aligners for children, teens, and adults seeking straighter teeth.

Dental Implants

Permanent, natural-looking replacements for missing teeth using the latest implant technology.

Pediatric Dentistry

Friendly, patient care designed to make young patients feel comfortable and cavity-free.

Emergency Care

Same-day appointments for toothaches, chipped teeth, and other urgent dental needs.

Meet Our Team

Our experienced and caring staff are dedicated to making every visit comfortable and stress-free.

Dr. Sarah Lin, DDS

Lead dentist with over 15 years of experience in family and cosmetic dentistry.

Dr. Marcus Ortiz, DMD

Specialist in orthodontics and dental implants, passionate about creating confident smiles.

Priya Nair, RDH

Our dental hygienist, known for her gentle touch and dedication to patient education.

Book an Appointment

Fill out the form below and our front desk will confirm your appointment within one business day.
